{{Quote|This is tame? I'd hate to see what the Wookiees drink!''"<br />"''What do you expect? They're Wookiees.|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]], to [[Groshik]], after tasting Cortyg brandy|<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>}}
'''Cortyg [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]]''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|incredibly hard]] drink brewed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It came in two different variations, the "wilder" side, drunk by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and the "tamer" Cortyg that tasted smoother. The "tamer" variant was sold to offworlders at high prices.

[[Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] owner and bartender [[Groshik]] offered Cortyg brandy to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] after a sabacc game in which Dessel won the sabacc pot and after Dessel was nearly killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]].
